issue.title: Json.reads fails for case classes with no parameters

repository.name: playframework
repository.description: The Community Maintained High Velocity Web Framework For Java and Scala.

issue.body:
Is there  a reason for this behavior?

```
scala> case class Emtpy()
defined class Emtpy

scala> Json.reads[Emtpy]
<console>:16: error: Apply of object Emtpy has no parameters. Are you using an empty case class?
              Json.reads[Emtpy]
                        ^
```

In a project I'm working on, this situation is fairly typical. It would be nice if this case produced a `Reads` that matched an empty `JsObject`.
